paragraphs: My name is Tom, and I am twelve years old. I am a student in Teacher Nick's class. On Monday, I found an envelope in my bag. My name was on the envelope, in blue pen. Inside, there was a short note on white paper. It said, "Secret! Meet me at the library at four o'clock. Walk along the school wall. Do not tell Hugo. From Ben." I knew the writing, because Ben is my friend.

Then Teacher Nick wrote on the board. "Geography test on Friday. All students must bring a map." Hugo looked at me and asked, "Why do you smile, Tom?" "I am just happy about the test," I said. Ben put one finger on his mouth. It was our secret. I looked at the clock again and again. The lesson was very long.

At four o'clock, I walked along the school wall to the library. Ben waited at a table with a big sheet of paper. "Hugo's birthday is on Friday," he said. "Every student will write a note for a card." "What a good secret!" I said. We looked everywhere for glue. At last, a girl in the library gave us some. I wrote my name and a few words for Hugo.

On Friday, we gave the big card to Hugo. Every student had a name on it. Hugo read the card and his face was happy. "Thank you, everyone," he said. Teacher Nick smiled and said, "Now open your maps." Ben's short note had all the key words. It told me who, when, and where.
text.summary: Tom finds a secret note in an envelope in his bag. It tells him when and where to meet Ben, and the plan is a birthday card for Hugo.
